description: Environmental examine texts for props the player can interact with. 35 entries. `scene` is a REAL map id as TeleportMenu.MAP_IDS and GameLoop list them -- it was authored against the MUSIC BED namespace (village_harmonia) and re-keyed 2026-10-12, because a consumer that translated bed names to map ids would be a second source of truth for map identity. Each entry has a prop type, a display name, and the text shown on examine.

harmonia_well.name: Stone Well
harmonia_well.text: The well is deeper than it looks. The bucket rope keeps going after the bucket is out of sight. You pull it up; the rope is dry the whole way. The well is not about water anymore. It has not been for some time.

harmonia_statue.name: Kneeling Knight
harmonia_statue.text: A stone knight kneels, sword sheathed. The plaque reads: 'He sheathed his sword once, and the kingdom survived one more day. That is all we ask of statues: a day.'

eldertree_gravestone.name: Unmarked Grave
eldertree_gravestone.text: The stone reads: 'Here lies a fool who asked the trees their names. The trees gave them.' There is no date. The trees nearby lean slightly toward the marker. They are listening to see if you ask.

frosthold_cairn.name: Black Stone Cairn
frosthold_cairn.text: A cairn of black stones. Each stone carries a single rune. The runes do not form a word you know. Your party member Rogue says they form a word they know. Rogue will not say what.

grimhollow_warning.name: Waterside Notice
grimhollow_warning.text: NOTICE: Do not swim. Do not wade. Do not look into the water for longer than a breath. The sign is old but the paint is fresh. Someone is maintaining it. You do not want to meet them.

maple_heights_hoa_board.name: HOA Notice Board
maple_heights_hoa_board.text: NEIGHBORHOOD WATCH: All irregularities must be reported within 24 hours. 'Irregularity' is defined in Appendix C. Appendix C has been classified at the county level. For reporting options, see Appendix D, which is also classified.

sandrift_caravan_post.name: Caravan Marker
sandrift_caravan_post.text: A weathered post with three painted arrows. Food: two days' walk. Water: three days' walk. Safety: indefinite. Someone has scratched out 'indefinite' and written 'conditional.' Someone else has scratched that out too.

brasston_clocktower_plaque.name: Clocktower Plaque
brasston_clocktower_plaque.text: COMMISSIONED AT 4:07. FIRST CHIMED AT 4:07. DEDICATED TO THE TEMPO, WHO KEPT US EARLY. The plaque has three identical lines. Your pocket watch reads 4:07. Your pocket watch did not read 4:07 a moment ago.

ironhaven_furnace_log.name: Furnace Log
ironhaven_furnace_log.text: FURNACE RECORD: ran continuous from Tick 4 to Tick 2137. No cooldowns. No maintenance. The foreman has been noted for endurance. The foreman has not been seen since Tick 2138.

rivet_row_union_board.name: Union Proposal Board
rivet_row_union_board.text: DRAFT PROPOSAL 17-C: Revise overtime pay for workers who did not clock in. Rationale: attendance is a spectrum, and management should not benefit from ambiguity that management introduced.

pipeline_gauge.name: Pressure Gauge
pipeline_gauge.text: PRESSURE: within tolerance. TOLERANCE: under review. REVIEWER: also under review. The needle is exactly centered. You have never seen a real gauge exactly centered. You consider this.

node_prime_terminal.name: Admin Terminal
node_prime_terminal.text:
$ uptime
up 2137 days, 11 users, load average: nan, nan, nan
$ who
root pts/0 (since tick 0)
$ _

The cursor blinks. It does not accept input. It blinks anyway. It is waiting to be observed.

node_prime_sticky.name: Post-It Note
node_prime_sticky.text: A sticky note on the monitor: 'DO NOT RESTART. He will notice.' No signature. The ink looks fresh. The ink has always looked fresh.

vertex_monolith.name: Black Tablet
vertex_monolith.text: A smooth black monolith. When you touch it, text appears: 'You are the one who touched it. This is noted.' You withdraw your hand. The text remains. You understand that withdrawing was also noted.

vertex_footprint.name: Single Footprint
vertex_footprint.text: A single footprint in the white sand. It is your size exactly. The angle of the toe matches your gait. You have not walked here. Your party agrees. The footprint does not argue.

castle_harmonia_foyer_narration.name: The Grand Foyer
castle_harmonia_foyer_narration.text: The foyer used to be where the palace made you feel welcomed. Now it makes you feel counted. Whatever you brought in, someone here has already estimated the weight of it.

castle_harmonia_petrified_courtier.name: Petrified Courtier
castle_harmonia_petrified_courtier.text: A woman in court dress, mid-objection. Her mouth is still shaped around the word she was saying. It looks like the letter O. The stone under her feet is a different color than the stone around it, as if it grew from her, not the other way.

castle_harmonia_overpainted_tapestry.name: Overpainted Tapestry
castle_harmonia_overpainted_tapestry.text: The old crest — a crown atop a book — is nearly gone under new paint. The paint is still tacky. You can see the crown through it if you tilt your head. Someone was in a hurry to cover it, and not much of a hurry to hide the work.

castle_harmonia_frozen_captain.name: Captain of the Guard
castle_harmonia_frozen_captain.text: The captain's spear is raised. His eyes track you as you pass. Neither the spear nor the eyes have moved in some time. On the floor by his boots there is a coin. It was likely his, and he was likely going to pick it up.

castle_harmonia_council_narration.name: The Council Chambers
castle_harmonia_council_narration.text: The council chambers used to draft laws. Now they draft memos to themselves about what a law is. The ink is fresher on the memos than on the laws.

castle_harmonia_abandoned_desk.name: Scriptweaver's Desk
castle_harmonia_abandoned_desk.text: The page in front of the empty chair has one line: 'The chancellor's authority derives from —' and then nothing. Whoever was writing knew the next word mattered, and left rather than write it.

castle_harmonia_broken_seal.name: Half-Broken Seal
castle_harmonia_broken_seal.text: The seal was set to hold a door closed. Someone tried to break it and mostly succeeded. What's left of the sigils spells nothing you can read, but you have seen the hand that drew them. Twice, in the cave, on walls the Warden guided you past.

castle_harmonia_worn_wax.name: The King's Seal
castle_harmonia_worn_wax.text: The king's personal seal, in its case, unused. Beside it, a stack of correspondence, all stamped. The wax stick on the desk is worn to nothing. Someone has been stamping. It has not been the king.

castle_harmonia_apartments_narration.name: The Royal Apartments
castle_harmonia_apartments_narration.text: The apartments are quiet in the way private rooms are quiet when the person who used to live in them has been asked, very politely, to stop.

castle_harmonia_relocked_door.name: The Prince's Door
castle_harmonia_relocked_door.text: The lock on the door is a new one. The old lock is on the floor beside it, still closed. Someone changed the lock without ever opening the door. Whoever was inside is inside twice now.

castle_harmonia_glyphs.name: Red Glyphs
castle_harmonia_glyphs.text: The glyphs are fresh. The paint is red the way paint is red when it isn't paint. They are drawn very neatly. The neatness is the part that unsettles.

eldertree_grafted_branch.name: The Grafted Branch
eldertree_grafted_branch.text: A branch from some other tree, bound into this one years ago and healed over. The graft took. The bark above it grows in a different direction from the bark below, as though the tree is still arguing with the part of itself that came from elsewhere.

frosthold_meltwater_mark.name: The Meltwater Mark
frosthold_meltwater_mark.text: A notch cut into the post where the meltwater reached. Below it, older notches, each one higher than the last. Someone has been carving them in the wrong order on purpose, so that the record reads as though the thaw is retreating.

grimhollow_lantern_ledger.name: The Lantern Ledger
grimhollow_lantern_ledger.text: A slate hung from the lantern post, tallying who owes light to whom. Most marks are paid off. One line has been owed so long the chalk has gone into the stone. Nobody has rubbed it out, which tells you the debt is still considered open.

brasston_redundancy_index.name: The Redundancy Index
brasston_redundancy_index.text: A card catalogue listing every backup the archive holds, and the backups of those. Item one is the index itself. Item two is a backup of item one. The drawer is full and the entries are all accounted for, which is the most worrying thing about it.

ironhaven_strike_ledger.name: The Strike Registry
ironhaven_strike_ledger.text: STRIKE RECORD: every entry carries a start date and a resolution date. In each one, the resolution comes first. A later hand has added a column headed WHY THIS IS FINE. The column is ruled but empty, and the ruling was done carefully.

maple_heights_appendix_form.name: Appendix C Request Form
maple_heights_appendix_form.text: FORM 14: To request a copy of Appendix C, state which section of Appendix C you are citing. Attach the relevant extract. A pen is chained to the box. The chain is longer than the form requires, as though someone expected people to stand here a while.

rivet_row_incident_numbers.name: The Incident Board
rivet_row_incident_numbers.text: INCIDENTS THIS QUARTER: 41, 42, 44, 45, 49. A note at the bottom reads: gaps are not incidents. A second note, in different handwriting, reads: gaps are where the incidents go. Neither note has been taken down.

sandrift_rain_tally.name: The Rain Ledger
sandrift_rain_tally.text: Three columns: rain that fell, rain that was promised, rain that was promised and did not come. The third column runs down the page and onto the back. The second column is in a hand that presses hard. The first is barely there at all.

vertex_threshold_tally.name: The Turning Count
vertex_threshold_tally.text: A sign set before the threshold: YOU MAY STILL GO BACK. Beneath it, a tally of those who did. The tally reads none. The wood under the tally has been scraped thin, the way a surface gets when a number is rewritten often enough.
